question: Can a prospective final challenge distinguish the supported finite services, transfer and economic claims against all credible ordinary controls without exposing final populations before complete method preparation?
success_criteria: Freeze complete code, dependency/environment closure and every selected method or representation before generating or revealing any final population.
Specify five-question and 21-duty coverage, fixed hypotheses, nulls, genuine transfer, paired units, denominators, practical effects, ties, missing outcomes and all material costs.
Implement and validate preparation/execution separation, source verification and preserved-unit retry/amendment rules on explicitly development-only fixtures.
Independently reconstruct material validity assumptions; preserve existing evidence and adverse findings.
Satisfy the observed Research60 floor, report the 960-minute checkpoint if crossed, synchronize records and stop before P3-10.
failure_criteria: Final case or outcome generation during preparation.
A comparator missing an ordinary shortcut, source cost, feedback or receiving-service obligation.
Post-exposure tuning represented as confirmatory, restartable units that erase failures, or unbound frozen dependencies.
reliable_gain: A usable, hash-bound prospective protocol and preparation barrier over accepted finite implementations.
exploratory_gain: Determine a discriminating genuine transfer design and a coverage/resource comparison whose interpretation survives failures, heterogeneous services and strong exact controls.
first_informative_check: Map existing executable entry points and complete preparation dependencies onto service-specific endpoints; try a development-only barrier and retry failure witness.
likely_failure: A single aggregate performance score could confound service obligations or favor a weak ordinary control; private-truth evaluation may accidentally execute while preparing methods.
timing_rule: Only observed principal D/L/E earns research credit. Preparation administration, publication, recovery and unattended waits are separate; overlapping agents add zero.
